messages.content: Derive a UE4.27 modular building migration. Output only JSON {"removedInstanceIds":["wall-right"],"addedInstances":[...]}. Each added instance has instanceId,moduleId,moduleVersion:1,positionCm:[x,y,z],yawDeg and optional attachment:{instanceId,socketId}. Preserve existing native identities; never replace the original door/window. Calculate geometry from the input. No executable code. Emit compact JSON on one line, with all ten instances. Room B front and back both use SM_FrontWall_B; right wall center is X=870.
